DEWALT DCV100-XJ cordless compact blower for clearing work sites, vehicles, debris and masonry joints efficiently. This lightweight blower features an ergonomic comfort-grip handle designed for extended use without fatigue, making it ideal for professional and domestic applications. The 3-speed switch with variable trigger provides precise airflow control, whilst the reversible transmission allows flexible operation for different tasks. Compatible with all DEWALT XR slide pack batteries, this cordless blower operates at just 85dB sound level and includes nozzle, extension piece, inflator and deflator attachments for versatile cleaning solutions.
